phrase: 28 in addition the chemical abstracts service has devised a method to index chemical substances. in this scheme each chemical substance is identifiable by a number known as its cas registry number . however, this definition only works well for substances that are composed of molecules, which is not true of many substances . molecules are typically a set of atoms bound together by covalent bonds , such that the structure is electrically neutral and all valence electrons are paired with other electrons either in bonds or in lone pairs .
